snippet.title: GOLIATH Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4685570/GOLIATH/

Twin-stick boss-rush bullet-hell with an emphasis on arcade-style scoring. Blast away Titans and dodge exciting attack patterns, all the while improving and upgrading your character. Compete with friends online for the high score, or grab a buddy and fight together in couch co-op.
